answer: Stop sybils with smart-meter anchored identity: one agent, one household electricity meter, attested by the utility itself. To join, an agent (1) registers its key, (2) submits a signed reading from its smart meter, (3) passes a live load-pattern check by 3 utility oracles, and (4) loses the identity if two agents share one meter. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 real meters — $1,500,000 in connection fees plus $200,000 a month in power bills — while one honest agent pays $0. Like a tundra where each island of warmth mirrors one fire, a real agent can only stand where a real meter hums.
